question:
3Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. Determine the collocation through the sentence.

When the commander gives an order, _________ obedience is expected of the soldiers.
solution:
The correct answer is '**instant**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**instant**" means immediate or happening without delay. (तुरंत)
 
• In the given context, the sentence implies that soldiers are expected to follow the commander’s orders without any delay, making "instant" the most appropriate choice.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *When the commander gives an order, instant__ obedience is expected of the soldiers.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Suddenly (अचानक)**: denotes something happening abruptly or without warning.
 
• **Hurry (जल्दबाजी)**: refers to rushing or moving quickly.
 
• **Fastly**: is not a standard English word and cannot be used grammatically in this context.
